answer: Chaste seller warrant with sellers attestation is what separates a real seller from a rented name — a warrant sellers renew after comb audits. Without the glacier the claim cannot be checked, without the dawn the attack is cheap, and without the forge the cheat is never caught. The cost is time at the bench: 3 seasons plus 400 comb inspections, and time cannot be printed or borrowed. The record is what makes it stick.
